items.quote: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people
items.claim: The officiant (unnamed 'He' in 9:18; 9:21 names Aaron in the same sequence) killed a bullock and a ram as a peace-offering sacrifice on behalf of the people.
items.object: the bullock and the ram (sacrifice of peace offerings for the people)
items.mechanism: animal sacrifice as peace offering on behalf of the people

items.quote: Aaron’s sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about
items.claim: Aaron's sons brought the sacrificial blood to him, and he sprinkled it all around the altar.
items.action: presented the blood; sprinkled it upon the altar round about
items.object: the blood of the peace offerings
items.mechanism: blood rite performed at the altar, with the sons assisting

items.quote: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver
items.claim: The fat parts taken from the bullock and the ram were the rump, the fat covering the inwards, the kidneys, and the caul above the liver.
items.object: fat of the bullock and ram: rump, fat covering the inwards, kidneys, caul above the liver
items.mechanism: the specified fat portions set apart for the altar

items.quote: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar
items.claim: The fat was laid on the breast portions, and then he burned the fat on the altar.
items.action: put the fat upon the breasts; burnt the fat
items.mechanism: burning the fat on the altar

items.quote: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before the LORD
items.claim: Aaron waved the breasts and the right shoulder before the LORD as a wave offering.
items.object: the breasts and the right shoulder

items.claim: The text says these ritual actions were done as Moses had commanded.
items.object: the peace-offering ritual carried out by Aaron and his sons
items.mechanism: doing the ritual under Moses' instructions
